title: Throughput-latency exploration for calibrated FP8/INT8 variants under mixed batch and long-context workloads
creator: Priya Shah
description: Run a structured performance and accuracy sweep for calibrated FP8 and INT8 model variants to understand throughput/latency trade-offs across mixed-batch workloads and long-context sequences. This ticket covers calibration strategy comparisons (per-tensor vs per-channel vs per-layer minmax vs KL), validation against LLM QA/LL integrity suites, and end-to-end throughput/latency measurement under realistic production routing policies (mixed batch sizes, cold vs warmed KV cache). Goal: produce a performance matrix and recommendations for default quant profiles and calibration pipelines to include in Optimize and the runtime model catalog.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Complete calibration sweeps for FP8 and INT8 on target models and record accuracy delta (perplexity and task evals) vs FP16 baseline. 2) Produce throughput (tokens/sec) and median/95/99 tail latency for batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16] and context lengths [2k,16k,32k] with/without KV cache warm. 3) Deliver standardized artifacts: CSV performance matrix, conda env/dockerfile, calibration artifacts (stats files), and a short confluence doc summarizing recommendations. 4) Provide guidance on when to prefer FP8 vs INT8 based on workload profiles (latency-sensitive vs throughput-sensitive).
test_plan: 1) Calibration: run three calibration strategies (per-tensor minmax, per-channel KL, per-layer symmetric) using the calib harness for each model/precision. 2) Accuracy validation: run eval suite (QA multi-choice set, LlamaEval perplexity subset, redwood-internal prompt-union) and compute relative accuracy drop vs FP16 baseline. 3) Throughput/latency bench: use runtime perf harness on dedicated test cluster (see testbed_config) for each calibration artifact. 4) Regression checks: compare generation quality on 200 sampled prompts; flag any >6% drop in task accuracy for further review. 5) Record all raw logs and upload to artifacts bucket.
testbed_config: Cluster: perf-ci-quant (4xA100-80GB), driver node with harness v2.3. Env: CUDA 12.1, cuDNN 9, torch-2.2.0, runtime commit a3f9c8. Network: isolated VPC. Measurement harness pins seed and warms KV cache for warmed runs. All runs use same tokenizer and prompt templates to avoid tokenization variance.
datasets: Calibration set: mix of 50k instruction-following windows (varied lengths) and 20k unlabeled continuations. Eval sets: 1) QA-micro-8k (2k prompts), 2) PPL-subset (Wiki + OpenWebText slices), 3) downstream-rerank-sim (synthetic relevance pairs).
expected_outcomes: FP8 yields ~1.5-2.0x throughput vs FP16 on throughput-optimized kernels for batch>=8
INT8 provides smaller model size and modest throughput gains (1.2-1.4x) but better stability on long-context when per-channel KL calibration applied
Per-layer minmax is fastest to compute but shows higher accuracy variance; KL per-channel preferred for production defaults
KV cache warm runs should show lower tail latency; batching interacts nonlinearly with long-context memory pressure
blockers: Need updated perf-ci AMI with kernel patches (ENG-26900)
Calibration harness edge-case causing OOM on 32k context with batch 16 (investigating)
